notes: Dual H-bridge for two DC motors or one bipolar stepper, VM 2.7–10.8 V (11.8 V abs. max – a full 3S LiPo at 12.6 V is above it). The outputs are N-channel FET bridges; in fast decay (coast) the winding current recirculates through the FETs' body diodes (datasheet 7.3.2) – no external clamp diodes. The two bridges may be paralleled (AIN1/BIN1, AIN2/BIN2, AOUT1/BOUT1, AOUT2/BOUT2; 8.2, figure 7) – the outputs carry drive tristate (they go Z in coast and sleep), so a paralleled pair is no LVL.contention. No behaviour model for a bridge driver: behavior none. Often bought as a breakout module (e.g. Pololu, Adafruit) – this entry is the IC. Library draft.

outputs: Z in coast and sleep (truth table 7.3.2) – drive tristate; OCP on every FET for shorts to ground, supply and across the winding (7.3.5.1) – short_proof
2026-10-31: outputs clamp = internal – SLVSAR1E: the bridge's body diodes clamp the winding (as read for the library draft)

2026-10-31: bridge outputs drive = bridge – the H-bridge outputs the datasheet of this draft describes (source above): driven high or low while enabled, off in sleep or coast; LEVELS counts them as defining their net (schema-gaps A2)
open: VCP needs 0.01 µF to VM, not to ground – needs.capacitor knows only a capacitor to ground, so it is a pin hint only

the outputs' clamping through body diodes has no field in the schema: REQ.missing (flyback) asks for a diode across a motor or solenoid on an output pin – for this bridge a false finding, and a single diode across a winding driven both ways would short the bridge
drive tristate makes a motor net driven only by these outputs an LVL.undefined/open_drain warning ('released, it floats') – a bridge output is no logic line; no pin type fits a bridge output
r_out_ohm is one number; the datasheet gives high and low side apart, by VM and temperature (maximum only at 85 °C)
nFault has no absolute maximum voltage in the datasheet (IOH given at 3.3 V)
i_out_max_a 1.5 A holds at VM = 5 V and 25 °C – derating with VM below 5 V and with temperature is not in the entry
